title: External review and reproducible handoff package
objective: Prepare a review-oriented package that exposes provenance, readiness and replay entry points without mutating external repositories.

in_scope: M0-M5 review package and handoff validation

deliverables.name: Review package manifest
deliverables.acceptance: Declare review artifacts, checks and replay entry points as data.

deliverables.name: Independent review verifier
deliverables.acceptance: Validate all required readiness and provenance reports without theorem synthesis.

deliverables.name: Review package negative tests
deliverables.acceptance: Reject missing or mutated review artifacts in temporary fixtures.

deliverables.name: Handoff summary
deliverables.acceptance: Emit a hash-bound review package report.

deliverables.name: M6 readiness gate
deliverables.acceptance: Produce a machine-checkable review readiness report.
